status: CONFIRMATORY: scored against the criteria registered before the runs

criteria.name: C1-lowerChannelIsPredictable
criteria.claim: the frozen model predicts the lower channel on unseen codes
criteria.criterion: observed lower-channel presence >= 0.65 among the 160 codes predicted high (BOTH and LOWER ONLY) and <= 0.30 among the 160 predicted low (PUSH ONLY and NEITHER)

criteria.name: C2-floodPushIsPredictable
criteria.claim: the frozen model predicts the flood push on unseen codes
criteria.criterion: observed flood-push presence >= 0.60 among the 160 codes predicted high (BOTH and PUSH ONLY) and <= 0.25 among the 160 predicted low (LOWER ONLY and NEITHER)

criteria.name: C3-bothModulesGoWithTheFace
criteria.claim: the PRIMARY test: with distance from trained matched, the BOTH cell has far more face-like end states than the rest
criteria.criterion: face-like rate in BOTH >= 0.30, exceeding the rate in the other three cells pooled by >= 0.15 (absolute), one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.01

criteria.name: C4-noOtherCellMatchesBoth
criteria.claim: neither module alone does as well
criteria.criterion: the BOTH cell's face-like rate is strictly higher than that of each of LOWER ONLY, PUSH ONLY and NEITHER

criteria.name: C5-theModulesInteract
criteria.claim: the two modules together do more than the sum of their parts
criteria.criterion: difference of differences (BOTH - LOWER ONLY - PUSH ONLY + NEITHER) of face-like rates >= 0.10 and its 95% bootstrap interval (2000 resamples within cells, seed 20251103) excludes 0

criteria.name: C6-gapFollowsTheModules
criteria.claim: the selectivity gap at the write peak follows the modules
criteria.criterion: mean gap in BOTH exceeds the mean of the other three cells' means by >= 0.08

criteria.name: C7-theReversedLowerChannelIsAgainstTheFace
criteria.claim: the mirror-image lower channel works against a face
criteria.criterion: across all new codes, the face-like rate among codes with the reversed lower channel observed is lower than among those without, one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05

criteria.name: C8-observedModulesNotJustPredicted
criteria.claim: it is the modules actually switched on, not the model's guess, that go with the face
criteria.criterion: across all new codes, the face-like rate among those with BOTH modules observed is >= 0.30 and exceeds that among the rest by >= 0.15, one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.01

criteria.name: C9-neitherCellIsQuiet
criteria.claim: without either module a face-like end state is rare
